title: Corner, second story 1BR Apt, Mission/Noe Valley w/community
body:
This sunny corner unit on the second floor of a classic Edwardian building sits right on the border of the Mission and Noe Valley — two of San Francisco's amazing neighborhoods. If you're looking for a place with real character, great light, and a genuine community around you, read on.

The Space Quintessential Edwardian/Victorian architecture has large windows, high ceilings and beautiful decorative details like wood mantel and hardwood floors. The living room has large bay windows and a gas fireplace, with warm afternoon light pouring in from two directions. A pair of double sliding doors connects the living room to the bedroom — creates an open feeling, much larger than the square footage suggests. The dine-in kitchen has good light as well, and the usual appliances: dishwasher, microwave, oven/stove, full-size fridge/freezer, plus cookware and dishware included.
The unit comes with a few furnishing pieces — plan to bring your own to make it home.

The Building Foyer with electronic door lock for secure deliveries. 400sq ft roof deck with tables, chairs, garden and bbq for outdoor gatherings. XL washer, dryer and clothesline. Bicycle storage.

Community We're a small community of makers, cyclists, activists, families, and a retiree. We share meals every few weeks and look out for one another. If you value neighbors over anonymous apartment living, you'll fit right in.

The Neighborhood Walkscore 98/100. Eight-minute walk to 24th St. BART (direct to SFO and the East Bay). Five-minute walk to the J-Church streetcar. Blocks from multiple Muni lines and tech shuttles. Caltrain connection via bike for Peninsula/Stanford commuters. Dolores Park, the Spanish Mission, and Bernal Heights are all in our backyard.

Rent: $2,900/mo (single occupant); +$200/mo per additional occupant
Includes: water, WiFi, recycling/trash/compost, free on-site laundry
$200 cleaning fee
Long-term lease preferred (6+ months / 1 year)
No subletting without express permission from landlord
Well behaved & kid friendly dogs and cats are possible with an extra deposit and cleaning charge.

If interested, please share: your intended move-in dates and lease length, number of occupants, and a few times you're available to see the space and anything else you'd like to share.

June 6, Saturday morning I may do an open-house if enough parties are interested.

Otherwise Sunday evenings, Mondays and Friday evenings preferred. Other evenings are possible.

Thanks for reading.
